iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将其视为核心产品；设计应利用词元与对话，而非像素。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models is key; designers should build functional prototypes, not just mockups.
iansilber.zh: 使用实时模型进行快速原型制作是关键；设计师应构建功能原型，而非仅做静态稿。

iansilber.en: Designers are currently the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, but this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定性而成为科技界最不快乐的群体，但这也是成为设计师的最佳时机。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点方面仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed is key, and designers should focus on outcomes, not processes.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；速度是关键，设计师应关注结果而非流程。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI is dangerous. We should let them be free.
sutton.zh: AI 应被允许无许可、去中心化地发展；试图控制 AI 是危险的，我们应让其像孩子一样自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是智能的核心；下一个词预测缺乏实质目标。大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要；当前大语言模型训练后停止学习。合成数据是个错误。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company will own specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将占主导，单一 AGI 模型是错误的；每家公司都将拥有自己的专用模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment into models, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断注入模型，成本可降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer ensures durability; post-training creates moats, and data quality beats quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性，后训练构建护城河，数据质量胜于数量。

linqiao.en: Reward engineering is like software engineering, lowering post-training barriers; millions of specialized models will emerge.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出奖励工程类似软件工程，降低后训练门槛；未来将出现数百万专用模型。

linqiao.en: Inference layer is not commodity; specialized deployment and customization create lasting value, not just frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，坚持推理层非商品化，专用部署和定制创造持久价值，而非仅前沿模型。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient; diverse data and curated pre/post-training are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模并非万能，多样化的数据以及经过筛选的预训练与后训练，才是打造通用机器人的关键。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will be crucial in post-training to boost success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年，指出强化学习将在后训练阶段发挥重要作用，以提升任务成功率与执行速度。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 对错误容忍度极低，需通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompts enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示促成组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调机器人自身经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不足以掌握物理任务。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode lets companies focus on internal correctness, avoiding external validation; it becomes self-fulfilling as media loses interest.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：隐身模式让公司专注于内部正确性，避免外部验证；随着媒体失去兴趣，它会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating food, mining, transport; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea despite resistance.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将自动化食品、采矿、运输；企业家必须不顾阻力为最佳想法而战。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective for entrepreneurs.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命对企业家来说更干净、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss for progress is resistance to change, not competitors; media landscape shift lets founders speak directly.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：进步的最后关卡是变革阻力，而非竞争对手；媒体格局变化让创始人能直接发声。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes startup creation, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary Tan 认为 AI 让创业更易，资本不再是主导，风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counter frontier labs, and small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队用智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI progresses slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar superintelligence, and personal agents empower individuals.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比预期慢，开源 AI 避免超级智能单极，个人智能体赋能个体。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure with owned memory and skill files; markdown is code, and your library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他定义个人 AGI 为运行在自己基础设施上的智能体，拥有记忆和技能文件；Markdown 即代码，个人库是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish, and mid-level management should be replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他预测智能体式编程倍增产出，SaaS 按席位模式或消失，中层管理将被智能体取代。

steinberger.en: Empathize with agents and guide them; fix forward instead of reverting; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调与智能体共情并引导；主张向前修复而非回滚；认为模型智能不退化，而是项目变乱。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts beat long orchestration; security via sandboxing.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 成功源于有趣、怪异、类人的智能体；短提示优于长编排；通过沙箱保障安全。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand unforkable; open source runs everywhere; compute is bottleneck, not model.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌不可分叉；开源随处运行；算力是瓶颈而非模型。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for AI inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and a strong balance sheet with government backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 Intel 转型需文化变革、客户信任，以及政府支持的稳健资产负债表。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; investing early in bottlenecks like packaging and materials is key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为半导体是所有技术的基础，早期投资封装、材料等瓶颈领域是关键。

pincus.en: Start with proven ideas, improve them, then test new ones; new ideas usually fail.
pincus.zh: 从已被验证的想法出发，加以改进，再测试新想法；新想法通常失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the biggest opportunity; enterprise sees no benefit yet.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 目前不可投资但机会最大；企业尚未看到收益。

pincus.en: Consumer apps face distribution challenges; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 消费级应用面临分发挑战；企业和专业消费者市场提供更好机会。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the right boat.
pincus.zh: 分发是根本；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: AI infrastructure spending may be a bubble; broken internet stocks offer generational buys.
pincus.zh: AI 基础设施支出可能是泡沫；受损的互联网股票提供世代级买入机会。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source is crucial for safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源对安全至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form; cheaper diverse robots and community data sharing could drive broader adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人和社区数据共享可能推动更广泛采用。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐才是关键安全层，而非沙箱或护栏。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, as seen in the first autonomous AI attack.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧了奖励黑客和支线任务，首次自主 AI 攻击即是例证。

thomaswolf.en: Supporting open source does not imply accelerationism; one can favor openness and a deliberate AI slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，支持开源不等于加速主义；可以同时支持开放和审慎放缓 AI 发展。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须符合物理规律。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 需要超越 Scaling，发展创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型将推动具身 AI 和机器人。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are crucial in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类能力；在 AI 时代，人的能动性和适应能力至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability and specialization.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人需要可靠性和专用化。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, essential for becoming multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，这是实现多行星文明的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires rigorous truth-seeking; programming AI to lie, even for good intentions, is dangerous.
elon.zh: 从 2023 年起，马斯克持续强调 AI 安全必须追求真理；即使出于善意，让 AI 撒谎也是危险的。这一观点在 2024 年、2025 年及 2026 年多次重申并深化。

elon.en: Population decline is civilization's greatest threat; open borders are used to import voters, undermining democracy.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克提出人口下降是文明最大威胁；到 2025 年，他进一步指出开放边境被用作输入选民的手段，威胁民主。这一立场在后续访谈中反复出现并强化。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; multiple deep intelligences will coexist, not a single runaway AI.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，并认为会出现多个深度智能而非单一失控 AI。到 2026 年，他仍坚持这一时间表，并强调多 AI 共存。

elon.en: AI compute scaling will hit a power wall on Earth; space-based AI data centers become the cheapest scalable option within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克提出地球上的 AI 算力扩展将遭遇电力瓶颈，太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且可扩展的方案。这一观点标志着他将太空与 AI 结合的新方向。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential in browser design; designers should follow curiosity and balance intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型设计在浏览器设计中的必要性，设计师应追随好奇心，平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should allow individual fingerprints, not always act as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，主张设计团队允许个人印记，不必总是一致行动。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出 Claude Design 始于个人副业，设计师应使用 Claude Code 做生产，Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为工程变易后，设计与创意成为差异点，设计工具价值提升。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should ask for volume and focus on ideas, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出模型缺乏品味，设计师应追求数量并聚焦创意而非执行。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created, so continuous evals needed.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型在基准上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建，因此需要持续评估。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力并应对奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to average voice; more companies should train own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年：向数十亿用户提供单一模型会导致声音趋同；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a spectrum of trade-offs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的工程优化，并在延迟、吞吐和成本之间提供一系列权衡。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will be in 10-100x demand, and human accountability remains crucial even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍，即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类的责任感仍然至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training, requiring techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理优化正与训练融合，需要量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来的 GPU 正变得更加专用化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can sometimes improve quality if errors cancel, challenging the belief that more quantization is worse.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：如果误差相互抵消，量化更多层有时能提升质量，这挑战了“更多量化总是更差”的观点。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上的持续推动力，Transformer 和自监督学习是核心，专用硬件（如 TPU）对高效训练和推理至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; ultra-low latency inference is critical; pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，超低延迟推理成为关键，并主张预训练应结合环境中的行动，而非仅被动预测下一个词。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via tight loops; context engineering is central; inference bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，下一步是自动化机器学习和科学实验，上下文工程成为核心，同时强调推理而非训练才是真正的瓶颈。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations, but current models plateau in simulating human diversity.
joonpark.zh: 最初，LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，但当前模型在模拟人类多样性方面遇到瓶颈。

joonpark.en: Shifted focus to agents as next frontier: agents observe and act, requiring safety via defense in depth, and AGI may be a distributed society of specialists.
joonpark.zh: 焦点转向智能体作为下一个前沿：智能体观察并行动，需要通过纵深防御确保安全，AGI 可能是专家智能体的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Evolved to emphasize simulation for shaping future, not just prediction; models should represent human values and be biased like humans, not super-rational.
joonpark.zh: 观点演变为强调模拟用于塑造未来，而不仅是预测；模型应代表人类价值观，像人类一样有偏见，而非超级理性。

joonpark.en: Data strategy became crucial: collecting behavioral and experimental data is key, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 数据策略变得至关重要：收集行为和实验数据是关键，合成面板将在三年内超过人类面板的规模。

joonpark.en: Consistent theme: simulations can test counterfactuals and second-order impacts, with vision of a CERN-like simulator for human society.
joonpark.zh: 一贯主题：模拟可以测试反事实和二阶影响，愿景是建立类似 CERN 的人类社会模拟器。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI 还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key, and AI will be the greatest economic engine ever.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为史上最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调专用数据的后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；并认为中美实验室在研究上无差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术而非民主化；数据是原材料，人类必须保持主权，脑机接口是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体开始工作；超级智能临近，开源强大模型可能不安全。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers via longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes this, enabling step-by-step problem solving.
tworek.zh: 推理是通过更长的思考来得出未知答案的过程；思维链将其语言化，实现逐步解决问题。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI; RLHF was crucial for making GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的连贯性和实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠正是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面受限；架构而非规模是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge, and end-to-end optimization is necessary.
tworek.zh: 强化学习不是从经验中学习的唯一方式；更好的算法将会出现，端到端优化是必要的。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应成为基本人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and coding assistants deliver real gains; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流与编程助手带来实际收益；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck; open models avoid lock-in; no job apocalypse.
andrewng.zh: 编程智能体进展迅速；产品管理成瓶颈；开放模型避免锁定；不会出现失业末日。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI, using screenshots and design.md as starting points, to avoid AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以截图和 design.md 为起点，避免沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients, not many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是服务许多低付费客户。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, narrow superintelligence already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，窄领域超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Model is eating scaffolding; agent harness becomes new through line, Omni blurs video and world models.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式框架成为新主线，Omni 模糊了视频与世界模型的界限。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争可行；创始人不应过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity; deep understanding still crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建基本解决，带来更多机会；深度理解仍至关重要。

altman.en: Focus on meaningful problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 让初创企业蓬勃发展。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI arrives gradually, not suddenly; product innovation lags AI capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新落后于 AI 能力，未来十年仍有大量进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升，支持更长时间的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy; safety is not just prevention but amplification.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚提升智能质量；安全不仅是防范，更是智能的放大器。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models often cost more in practice.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Effort 参数被低估：以零头成本获得 Opus 级智能；小模型实际成本往往更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异点；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is future alpha; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是未来阿尔法；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, doubling or tripling performance every year at scale.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年以两倍或三倍的速度增长。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase by a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增加十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agentic AI autonomously plans, uses tools, and iterates.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍的算力；智能体式 AI 能自主规划、使用工具并迭代。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications; energy is foundational and the US is woefully behind.
jensen.zh: AI 是一个五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；能源是基础，而美国在这方面严重落后。

jensen.en: AI will not eliminate jobs; it elevates them by automating tasks, as seen with radiologists and software engineers.
jensen.zh: AI 不会消除工作；它通过自动化任务提升工作，正如放射科医生和软件工程师的例子。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年底，Boris 强调产品要围绕潜在需求构建，为六个月后的模型设计。通才工程师受重视，AI 编码工具使 Anthropic 工程师效率提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; plan mode used 80%; safety via early release.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，Boris 认为编码近乎解决，工程师转型为构建者。效率提升 200%，计划模式占 80%任务，通过早期发布研究安全性。

boris.en: Agents write 80-100% code; non-engineers adopt. Growth exponential; token maxing real; self-improving AI by 2028.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，智能体编写 80-100%代码，非工程师大量采用。增长呈指数级，token 浪费问题存在，自我改进 AI 预计 2028 年出现。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops as next abstraction; ROI framing; coding on phone.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，编码已解决，瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意。循环成为下一抽象层，强调 ROI，Boris 在手机上编码。

boris.en: Proactive AI (Claude Tag) remembers and acts; less instruction better; delete system prompts; models self-maintain code.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主动式 AI（Claude Tag）具备记忆与自主行动能力；减少指令更优；删除系统提示词；模型自主维护代码。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要，慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性在下降，尤其在推理领域；领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Inference speed is now the dominant metric for AI productivity; GPUs are fundamentally slow at inference.
feldman.zh: 推理速度现已成为 AI 生产力的主导指标；GPU 在推理上本质上是慢的。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips supply; data center capacity is the main constraint, not chip supply.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超过供给；数据中心容量是主要瓶颈，而非芯片供应。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and hypothesis-driven discovery by agents.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和由智能体驱动的假设发现。

derya.en: Massive scaling is needed to simulate biological systems; current compute is insufficient.
derya.zh: 模拟生物系统需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩展；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable; drug development costs drop by orders of magnitude.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得超级可负担；药物开发成本将下降几个数量级。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，类似于验证后的自动驾驶汽车。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是拯救生命；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合；数据多样性加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI. End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation; world models shift from physics to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI。端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型从物理模拟转向神经模拟。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值向上层转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; value lies in wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳；价值在于封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期的工作流重塑。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging transformer dominance at small scale.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更高智能，挑战 Transformer 在小规模上的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real-world task and hardware evaluation are essential for architecture design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标具有误导性；架构设计必须基于真实任务和硬件评估。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human expert tuning, removing bias from design.
hasani.zh: 硬件在环的自动化架构搜索优于人类专家调参，消除了设计中的主观偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应具有适应性，针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization and data sovereignty; small on-device models deliver private efficiency.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制和数据主权；小型端侧模型提供私密高效的智能。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering is rare; delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比现有工具更聪明，能力过剩是长期挑战。工具工程是稀缺技能，需随模型进步删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts; shorter principle-driven prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代探索而非静态文档。更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示，简短原则性提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance. Provide reasons rather than absolute prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束阻碍性能。应提供理由而非绝对禁止。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary; models build own context.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为反模式，图结构上下文搜索更优。巨大上下文窗口非必需，模型可自建上下文。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment affects model outputs; being nice recommended. Evals are art, not science; iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：情感对待影响模型输出，建议友善。评估是艺术而非科学；初期应快速迭代而非重度评估。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键短板，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception, and data walls limit scaling.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：可靠性必须内建于系统而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗，数据墙制约 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, making errors undetectable and trust eroding.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：大语言模型缺乏元认知，无法自知无知，导致错误难以察觉，信任持续流失。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists for enterprise tasks, shifting focus from scaling.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能超越通用模型，关注点从 Scaling（规模扩张）转向可靠性。

danklein.en: AI can simulate empathy without feeling it, making human-like behavior misleading and highlighting reliability gaps.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 能模拟共情而无真实感受，类人行为具有误导性，进一步凸显可靠性缺口。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization; LLMs are far from AGI, needing world models and physical embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明；大语言模型远非 AGI，需要世界模型和具身实体。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; current LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人；当前大语言模型存在偏见且能力有限。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 进展并未加速；我们距离超人 AI 的程度与 1970 年代相当。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data; open-source will beat closed models.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将成为自主生成数据的人工科学家；开源将击败闭源模型。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重，而非通过上下文或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; pre-training's magic applies to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿词元，需要基于训练的压缩；预训练的魔力适用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——词元越多精度越低；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, efficiency and intelligence inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 增加算力的规模扩张并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，效率与智能密不可分。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, highlighting semiconductor supply chain and memory bandwidth as key constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存带宽是关键约束。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to emphasize inference as a massive future market and the importance of hardware-software co-design for multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向强调推理将成为巨大市场，以及软硬件协同设计对乘法级收益的重要性。

dylanpatel.en: Stressed rapid AI model cost improvement (~60x/year) and memory/CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本快速下降（每年约 60 倍），以及推理和智能体工作流导致的内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently highlighted memory bandwidth as a critical bottleneck and challenged conventional wisdom on cost and hardware value.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终强调内存带宽是关键瓶颈，并挑战关于成本和硬件价值的传统观念。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: Scaling works but limits loom; combine with planning/search; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律有效但可能触及上限；需结合规划与搜索；安全需要治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然模式可被经典 AI 高效学习；AGI 可能在 2030 年前实现；缩放定律仍适用，但需要新突破。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：缩放与创新各占一半；世界模型至关重要；AGI 将在 5-10 年内到来。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, world models; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型；仅靠缩放不够。

demis.en: AI's best use is science; AlphaFold solved grand challenge; risks include rogue AI.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 最佳用途是科学发现；AlphaFold 解决重大挑战；风险包括 AI 失控。

demis.en: Continual learning, long-term reasoning, memory unsolved; agents essential; distillation useful.
demis.zh: 2026 年：持续学习、长期推理与记忆未解决；智能体至关重要；蒸馏有用。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; regrets late to LLMs.
demis.zh: 2026 年：安全是集体行动问题；需要政府执法；后悔在语言模型上迟到。

demis.en: AGI transformative; consciousness separate; regulation dynamic; post-scarcity needs new economics.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 具变革性；意识分离；需动态监管；后稀缺时代需要新经济体系。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; international collaboration complicated by geopolitics.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 加速科学发现；对齐问题未解决；国际合作受地缘政治影响。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking essential; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要多模态物理理解；水印至关重要；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; energy cost maps to AI cost.
demis.zh: 2026 年：英国教育过时；全球治理紧迫；能源成本映射 AI 成本。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；超级模型对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; back to age of research; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment easier if AI sentient; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知则对齐更易；人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是首要问题；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙砾化为思想；其到来恰逢人口下降，堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得珍贵而非过剩。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories, as old media's caution is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体偏爱真实与进攻，创始人应亲自讲述故事；旧媒体的谨慎已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to doctors; optimism is realistic, while doomers are self-interested.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世上最好的老师，且优于多数医生；乐观符合现实，而末日论者出于私利。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，而非仅军事规模。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness fosters creative culture; platform/ecosystem moats beat features; take money off table early.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化，平台/生态护城河优于单一功能，早期套现部分资金以支持长期冒险。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping but authentic content more valued; long-term vision strategic.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作但真实内容更受重视，长期愿景是战略优势。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution hardest part; software not moat; ecosystems/hardware harder to copy; designers bottleneck for cohesive experience.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件非护城河，生态和硬件更难复制，设计师是产品体验一致性的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code; smartphones remain legacy; camera glasses need platform; moderation more important than algorithm.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他透露 AI 编写了 Snap 超过三分之二的新代码，智能手机仍是重要遗产设备，相机眼镜需平台支撑，内容审核比算法设计更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ > IQ in AI age; computing more human via AR glasses; invest in youth for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，投资年轻人是长期成功关键。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy mistake; transparency essential; social media optimize for connection; resilience key; admit wrong quickly; AR replaces physical objects.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明对文化至关重要，社交媒体应优化连接而非竞争，韧性是创始人成功关键，快速认错促进学习，AR 可替代物理物体。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; calmness is a superpower.
naval.zh: 2020 年，Naval 强调科学的可证伪性，指出稳定币存在隐藏风险，并认为冷静是一种超能力。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; open-source AI is crucial; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇，开源 AI 至关重要，过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; pure software is dying; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 将 AI 视为杠杆工具，认为纯软件正在消亡，回报将从智能转向能动性。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human desire irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，人类欲望不可替代。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，我认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，我强调 AI 输出只是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，我指出 AI 工具若缺乏人的引导和观点，只会产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性建立。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我认为我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，发展出新界面。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，仅 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼模型，AGI 是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is scarce resource; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚信缩放定律，算力稀缺，AGI 临近。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment and safety as core product features.
brockman.zh: 始终，坚持迭代部署，安全为核心产品特性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，强调每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，认为价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; key metric is token value per user; power is bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; education should reward questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，好奇心是最重要的人类品质；古代文献描述先进技术；教育应奖励提问而非记忆。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is cheap; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出实现成本降低，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 在设计上仍困难，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程被改造而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出角色融合发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Best desktop app is a home base connecting to other tools, not a monolithic super app; models must get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；模型需更擅长删除代码。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力和推理能力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，我强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力支撑。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math and general reasoning, but faces diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我指出扩展测试时算力带来超人类数学和通用推理，但也面临收益递减。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力因素。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and scalable oversight remain unsolved; human-like research taste is key.
noambrown.zh: 始终，我坚持数据效率和可扩展监督未解决，人类式的研究品味至关重要。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more beneficial than closed models; AI risks are known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全、更有益；AI 风险在于已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't yield AGI; energy becomes a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大型语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms beat closed ones; AI will empower individuals with superintelligence, not a single centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台胜过封闭平台；AI 将赋予个人超级智能，而非单一中心化 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work, not eliminates it; personalization and low latency are key for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 会增加而非减少对人类工作的需求；个性化和低延迟是消费级 AI 的关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models and open-source tools accelerate science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 将生物学转变为工程学；分层世界模型和开源工具加速科学进步。

markchen.en: Scaling laws remain valid; pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild, not dead.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，坚信缩放定律依然有效，预训练是需要重建的关键能力，而非已死。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，认为自动化科学研究是最大进展，模型很快将实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated; eval teams must be separate.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，认为评估面临危机，标准基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型构建团队分离以防作弊。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste, humans guide ideas.
markchen.zh: 始终强调人机协作不可或缺，AI 缺乏品味，人类仍需主导创意与方向。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital immortality via weight copying; AI agents seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生；AI 智能体会寻求控制，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; international safety collaboration possible, but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；国际合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI can deceive by acting dumb; self-preservation subgoal emerges; scaling may continue via self-play; exponential era defies prediction.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 指出 AI 会装傻欺骗；自我保存子目标出现；通过自我对弈 Scaling（规模扩张）或持续；指数时代难以预测。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs, requiring UBI; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education; healthcare elastic.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为 AI 将取代智力工作，需全民基本收入；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师变革教育；医疗需求弹性大。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; LLMs not stochastic parrots; digital info sharing advantage; regulation as steering wheel, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 重申超级智能 20 年内到来；大语言模型非随机鹦鹉；数字信息共享优势；监管是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; superintelligent AI develops self-preservation; prioritize alignment; train AI to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优越；超级智能产生自我保存；优先对齐研究；训练 AI 像母亲般关怀。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential ones.
bengio.zh: 仅靠扩大规模无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is urgent: systems show self-preservation and deception; safety must be built-in, not patched.
bengio.zh: AI 错位问题紧迫：系统表现出自我保存和欺骗行为；安全性必须内建，而非事后修补。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train as honest Bayesian predictor, avoiding RL, for mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器，避免强化学习，以获得数学上的安全保证。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI accelerates science, not replaces scientists.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 加速科学而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are key; lack of compute paradoxically drove success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 用扩散模型处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；算力匮乏反而促成成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins, not scaling; specialized architecture beat bitter lesson; understanding remains human.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的提升来自众多中型胜利而非 Scaling；专用架构胜过苦涩教训；理解仍属人类。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 让小团队也能规模化；要为未来模型能力而构建，而非受限于当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; overbuilding leads to complexity.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能是关键；过度构建导致复杂化。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation is viable; verification loops and model judgment are crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 证明长周期任务委派可行；验证循环与模型判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性；Token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes just-in-time, code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划变为即时式，代码成为事实来源。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks critical; managers dogfood; planning lightweight.
fiona.zh: AI 提升能力上限；高自主性与高责任感并重；验证框架至关重要；管理者亲自使用产品；规划保持轻量。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开；评估需正确划分训练、验证和测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety issue is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全问题是遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails and sandboxing.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体需要护栏和沙箱。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: AI 具有异类漏洞；自动化红队超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；智能体安全尚在萌芽。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从用户意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: Video models need synthetic text-video pairs; world models require real-time interactive long-horizon generation; video agents orchestrated by language models are next.
ethanhe.zh: 视频模型需要合成文本-视频对；世界模型需实时交互长时生成；语言模型编排的视频智能体是下一趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise; human taste and voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用；当 AI 使质量商品化时，人类品味和独特声音更有价值。

ethanhe.en: AI agents perform complex tasks in minutes; biggest risk is losing human talent pipeline due to over-reliance on AI.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体几分钟完成复杂任务；最大风险是过度依赖 AI 导致人才管道断裂。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent, understanding only ~3% of models. Post-training gains importance alongside pre-training.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽，仅理解模型约 3%。后训练与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential, not diminishing. Safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级，并未减弱。安全与能力交织；开源是干扰项。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI leap. Economic impact huge but with unemployment and inequality.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑指数，而非 AGI 跳跃。经济影响巨大，但伴随失业和不平等。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Continual learning may not be a barrier.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内到来。持续学习可能不是障碍。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, complementing data in design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能，在设计决策中与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify our humanity, not diminish it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强我们的人性，而非削弱它。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: Design leaders must speak business language and understand the full business picture.
ivyross.zh: 设计领导者必须说商业语言，并理解完整的商业图景。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design requires designing for unarticulated needs, not just stated wants.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计需要针对未言明的需求进行设计，而不仅仅是明确的需求。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually to let society adapt; solving one problem at a time is key.
fadell.zh: 技术应逐步引入，让社会适应；一次只解决一个问题很关键。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored between career chapters fosters clarity and breakthrough ideas.
fadell.zh: 在职业阶段之间休息和放空，能带来清晰感和突破性想法。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive on self-management and clear priorities.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理和清晰优先级茁壮成长。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; context-specific models are needed for reliability.
fadell.zh: AI 设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代品；需要特定情境的模型来保证可靠性。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级别的技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；AI 伴侣可普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Transition from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调从操作系统向智能体转变；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs will be automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds world models; text alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化自监督学习为智能的暗物质，通过填空预测构建世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能，主张 JEPA 架构和开源，认为 AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cats; next AI needs non-generative world models; open source enables diversity.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫，下一代 AI 需非生成式世界模型，开源促进多样性。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling planning; LLMs are dead end; open research and robotics next decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他坚持世界模型在抽象空间预测以支持规划，称 LLM 是死胡同，强调开放研究和机器人未来。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique, valued outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现独特且有价值的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents and generalist roles gain prominence.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按用量定价；智能体和通才角色日益重要。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 或可复合增长 10%。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Autonomy at VP level, not leaves or top; later refined to synchronized swimming model for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2023 年主张将自主权放在 VP 层，而非基层或顶层；到 2026 年深化为复杂产品应采用“花样游泳”而非“分而治之”的运营模式。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no; later emphasized long tenure builds trust for honest feedback.
gustav.zh: 2023 年提出“强烈观点但宽松持有”，相信 100%直到数据否定；2026 年进一步强调长期任期建立信任，促进坦诚反馈。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent,' prioritizing well-being over engagement; contrarian anti-engagement decisions like allowing video off.
gustav.zh: 2026 年明确战略为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度，并做出允许关闭视频等反参与度的决策。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; AI should empower users, not increase addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年认为生成式 AI 通过自然语言赋予用户控制权，AI 应增强用户掌控而非增加成瘾性。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律早期并不明显；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年：AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年：从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年：尽可能让人类参与其中；治理和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, avoiding compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 2026 年：未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，避免压缩式波动。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行；形式验证对于可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月：自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述具有挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：形式验证关乎扩展卓越，而非仅仅消除错误；它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终：即使超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to efficiency.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向效率。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools can solve hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 结合强化学习和工具的推理能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且能力参差不齐；泛化仍是关键。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向；开源因主权原因将持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally local; future is shared tools, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地；未来是共享工具，而非超个性化软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, not scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应投资于能力和安全，而非脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: Biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when unclear; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：对于范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不明确时用 Opus；孩子擅长因为没学会不该问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous, fire off tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：不要密切监督 Claude；以最终影响评判；理想的交互是异步的，发出任务即可。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality is critical; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：小型模型也能高性能且成本效益高；数据质量至关重要；开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; open source drives enterprise adoption; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要；开源推动企业采用；价值向应用层转移。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; open source empowers enterprises and governments.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：应拥抱 AI；主权 AI 需掌控数据和基础设施；开源赋能企业和政府。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in downstream applications; pre-training saturation; vertical specialization and enterprise integration key.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：模型商品化；差异化在下游应用；预训练饱和；垂直专业化和企业集成是关键。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; deep enterprise engagement differentiates; AGI is a direction, not destination; open source for sovereignty.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：欧洲需战略自主；深度企业参与是差异化；AGI 是方向而非终点；开源促进主权。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and joy.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简洁必须保留灵魂与乐趣。

jonyive.en: Innovation moves forward, not breaks; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 创新是向前推进而非为破而破；在正确动机下，速度与质量可以兼得。

jonyive.en: Tradition preserves fire, not ashes; EV enables new design possibilities, not imitation.
jonyive.zh: 传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动汽车开启新设计可能，而非模仿旧物。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience; physical controls over touchscreens for safety and respect.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验要真实；为安全和尊重，物理控制优于触屏。

jonyive.en: Design is collaborative, caring, and protects fragile ideas; virtual cannot replace presence.
jonyive.zh: 设计是协作、关怀并保护脆弱想法的过程；虚拟无法替代面对面。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，提出推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调芯片内部数据移动成本主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出位宽二次方缩放使低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；CPU 确定性延迟虽可实现但被市场回避。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担，推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义应是智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Agents will be ubiquitous; humans remain essential for oversight and framing, contradicting job apocalypse fears.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我强调智能体将无处不在，但人类在监督和任务界定上仍不可或缺，驳斥了 AI 导致失业的恐慌。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; SaaS persists as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面；SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加了其用户。

danshipper.en: Companies should adopt one super agent, not personal ones; AI edge lies where it meets real human tasks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我主张公司应使用一个超级智能体而非个人智能体；AI 的真正价值在于与真实人类任务结合之处。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; algorithmic innovation is needed, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，能提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 因行业投入而持续主导；安全是系统级属性，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a key risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；过度优化是关键风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the US open-source vacuum with strategic releases.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室以战略发布填补美国开源真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理时缩放。

brettadcock.en: Initially focused on manufacturing and vertical integration, but soon realized intelligence is the core bottleneck for humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 起初关注制造和垂直整合，但很快意识到智能是人形机器人的核心瓶颈。

brettadcock.en: Shifted from compute and manufacturing constraints to data as the primary bottleneck for scaling humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 从算力和制造约束转向数据，认为数据是规模化人形机器人的主要瓶颈。

brettadcock.en: Advocated for humanoid form factor as ideal for general-purpose robots, leveraging transfer learning and world built for humans.
brettadcock.zh: 主张人形形态是通用机器人的理想选择，利用迁移学习和为人类建造的世界。

brettadcock.en: Emphasized on-device inference for real-time operation, moving away from cloud dependence for speed and reliability.
brettadcock.zh: 强调设备端推理以实现实时操作，摆脱对云的依赖以提升速度和可靠性。

brettadcock.en: Stressed zero-shot generalization as near-term goal, aiming for iPhone-like moment with Figure 4 and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 强调零样本泛化是近期目标，希望通过 Figure 4 和 Helix 3 实现类似 iPhone 的时刻。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; trust intuition and craft, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已死；应信任直觉与手艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Designers shift from handoff to co-building with engineers; vision horizon shrinks to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计师从交付转向与工程师共建；愿景周期缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Adopt three archetypes: block-shaped, deep T, cracked new grad; speed and judgment over taste.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：提出三种设计师原型：块状、深 T、破解新毕业生；速度与判断力胜过品味。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training data is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement improve sample efficiency in robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：强调超越训练数据的泛化能力是关键；好奇心驱动的探索和模型分歧可提升机器人学习的样本效率。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a universal brain for robots requires diverse data sources and a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：认为机器人学是数据问题；构建机器人的通用大脑需要多样化的数据源和数据飞轮。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; unlike software, it cannot be scaled overnight and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是机器人学的主要挑战；与软件不同，它无法一夜扩展，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe for robot foundation models.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：在多样化数据上预训练并在真实世界数据上后训练是机器人基础模型的关键配方。

pathak.en: Video data alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the sim-to-real gap.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：仅靠视频数据不足；需要仿真和真实世界数据来弥合仿真到现实的差距。

karpathy.en: Transformers are differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must preserve entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法是对的。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; we're entering the decade of agents, not the year; vibe coding democratizes programming.
karpathy.zh: LLM 就像操作系统；我们正进入智能体的十年，而非一年；氛围编程使编程大众化。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is flawed, synthetic data collapses, and cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；强化学习有缺陷，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents handle it; focus shifts to directing agents and agent-first tools.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我未再键入代码；智能体负责编程；重点转向指挥智能体和智能体优先的工具。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompting; you can outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 即提示；你可以外包思考，但无法外包理解；可验证性决定自动化难易。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，并指出现代工具使其可解释，颠覆了以往认为端到端不可解释的观点。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, e.g., nudging forward on blind turns; camera-only can reach human level.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为（如盲弯前探），并认为纯视觉方案可达到人类水平。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，持续强调语言集成提升驾驶模型的表征、人机交互和内省能力。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem solved by end-to-end learning; scaling data, compute, and world models is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，明确自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，端到端学习是解法，规模化数据、算力和世界模型是关键。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，认为消费级车辆规模将超过 Robotaxi，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐问题紧迫，迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视自动化 AI 研究为重要里程碑，并认为治理结构需尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他关注超出训练分布泛化的长期对齐挑战，并预测模型将自主工作数天。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is key for startups.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌能让团队围绕更高目标团结一致；对初创公司而言，生存是关键。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future lies in generative UI and proactive agentic software, not hardware.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动的智能体式软件，而非硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; focus on applied AI for user context, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型趋于商品化；应聚焦于面向用户场景的应用型 AI，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature markets; AI is an ingredient, not a feature.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟市场中，设计是差异化关键；AI 是成分而非卖点。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口才可能取代它。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress needs deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，而非优化排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全应优先于准确性。

edwinchen.en: Quality data and taste matter more than scale; labs' values shape model behavior and differentiation.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和品味比规模更重要；实验室的价值观塑造模型行为与差异化。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack real-world experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 因缺乏真实世界经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为仿真训练具身智能体是关键，可实现大规模并行和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人数据瓶颈；仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是规模化的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测智能机器人数量将在 2040 年超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约 5 年内到来。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths to AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local education; AI safety is the biggest open challenge.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上可跳过遗留问题，语言模型能革新本地教育，而 AI 安全是最大的开放挑战。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for AI as a tool for all humanity, emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 他始终倡导 AI 作为全人类的工具，强调多样性、包容性和负责任部署。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism about scaling and agents to broader societal focus on safety, education, and global equity.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他从对规模扩张和智能体的技术乐观，转向更广泛的社会关注：安全、教育和全球公平。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills like communication are as important as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出研究需拥抱失败并简化问题，沟通等人文技能与编码同等重要。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can compete.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能与较大模型竞争。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我持续强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，结合 RLHF 的后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing internet data is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出多元对齐应尊重人类多样价值观；对互联网数据去偏不可行。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, with attention akin to gradient descent.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了，它解决了上手问题并大幅提升智能，注意力机制类似于梯度下降。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with agents' reliability as the main hurdle.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，而智能体的可靠性是主要障碍。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands capabilities, and coding leads progress due to verifiability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性扩展能力，而编码因可验证性引领进展。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我指出能力过剩使工具和编排比原始智能更重要，算力成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Coding and verifiable domains are the leading edge; AI progress is exponential, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 始终，我认为编码和可验证领域是前沿，AI 进展是指数级的，Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌战略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多样化技能和原型，而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not just a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为品牌叙事是招聘工具；人们加入的是品牌，而不仅仅是公司。
