nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems. AI is a creative partner, and design tools should be interoperable with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作。AI 是创意伙伴，设计工具应互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable. Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。作品集应重工艺与意图，而非过程文档。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads. IC tracks and specialist pigeonholing limit growth; generalists often outperform specialists.
nadchishtie.zh: 小而精的设计师与工程师团队优于跨职能大组。独立贡献者路线和专家化会限制成长；通才常胜过专才。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days. Side projects can outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用就像早期忽视互联网。副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring managers look for high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive and learning aptitude. Paid test work provides more signal than any other interview stage.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘经理看重有内在驱动力和学习能力的高成长曲线者。付费试工比其他面试环节更能提供有效信号。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; focus on alignment and robustness; PhD path recommended.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全需要实证研究，聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，建议通过博士路径进入该领域。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability key; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性，对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，呼吁外部监管。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习是强学习信号，强化学习需要层次化推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning boosts RL sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，转向无监督学习提升强化学习样本效率，并指出硬编码先验知识可能限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks; brain inspires but AI is less general.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，认为预训练语言模型可迁移推理到非语言任务，大脑启发 AI 但当前 AI 通用性远不及。

truell.en: Programming shifts from text editing to AI-integrated environments; natural language won't be primary—examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，编程从文本编辑转向 AI 集成环境；自然语言不会成为主要方式，示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Future programming moves to higher-level intent specification; taste and logic design skills become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，未来编程转向更高层次的意图描述；品味和逻辑设计技能变得更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模云厂商主导；初创企业应聚焦应用层 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages must prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code, requiring root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言需优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需进行根本原因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will be as crucial as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体将变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使软件价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者从编写者转变为运营者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges; generalists leveraging AI outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将被与其他智能体比较而非人类；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；善用 AI 的通才将胜过专才。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but neural networks remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为通过更多算力和数据扩大模型规模能带来更智能的 AI，但神经网络内部仍是炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity, but won't alone achieve AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为未来模型需要万亿级上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构以实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; agentic capabilities are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；智能体能力对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，且 AGI 的经济影响被低估。
